arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady pace.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s >= 150 and empties_in_m_pod < remaining_m - maximum(300, 0.1 * remaining_m)
arguments.message: pod reserve runs out well before the finish at this shaft power (cue let_go was given at 1 min because holding the pack took about 232 W vs 191 W critical shaft power)

text: let_go cue: holding the pack took about 232 W shaft against 191 W critical, emptying the pod reserve in under 900 m.

arguments.text: Close the gap, get back on that wash and stay.

arguments.message: pod reserve under 25 percent and still overspending: plan was hang on to the pack (on-wash cost about 205 W shaft) until here, then let_go and settle at about 191 W shaft to keep the rest for the sprint
no wash (push_local near push_along) yet shaft power is above the sustainable level: pack likely lost, settle to own pace

text: hang_on cue: pack settled, the wash cost only about 205 W shaft (4 percent over sustainable) for clearly more speed; let go later near 25 percent pod reserve.

arguments.text: Pack is gone. Ease a touch, settle at 2:31 pace.

arguments.message: off the wash and shaft power above the sustainable level for 75 s (an ease cue to about 196 W shaft, 2:31 display pace, was given at 5 min)

text: ease cue: wash lost, shaft 204 W vs 196 W sustainable would empty the pod reserve 3 km early.

arguments.text: Ease off now, you are burning too much. Long and smooth.

arguments.message: pod reserve under 20 percent and shaft power still above critical: blow-up risk (ease cues at 5.0 and 7.6 min; the paddler raised power after the first one)

text: ease cue repeated: shaft rose to 212 W after the first ease, pod reserve 32 percent would empty in 650 m of 4450 m.

arguments.message: the POD reserve reads empty but speed at this rate holds for 2 min: shaft critical power is probably set low; consider set_critical_power with cp_shaft_w near the steady shaft power held (the boat-model reserve has read empty since 3 min because the race shaft-to-boat efficiency, about 0.77, is above the test value, 0.64)
under 900 m to go with pod reserve left: plan the finishing sprint from the pod reserve

text: no cue: ease was cued 30 s ago (cue gap); boat reserve conflict explained by efficiency, watches now use the pod reserve.

arguments.text: Too hard. Drop the effort a notch and hold it there.

text: ease cue: shaft 215 W, 24 W over critical, pod reserve 16 percent empties in under 300 m; earlier ease cues not followed.

arguments.message: pod reserve empty and shaft power still above critical; three ease cues (5.0, 7.6, 8.9 min) were not followed and shaft-to-boat efficiency is falling (fatigue)

text: no cue: last cue 42 s ago (cue gap); watch set to wake when the pod reserve is empty.

arguments.text: Tank is empty. Ease to 2:41 pace and recover.

text: ease cue with pace: pod reserve empty at 225 W shaft, efficiency and speed falling; a controlled settle beats a blow-up.

arguments.text: Drop the rate two, long strokes, let the breathing settle.

text: rate_down cue: 6 percent fade with the pod reserve empty; the best rate drops when tired.
no cue: paddler is below critical power after emptying the reserve and the pod reserve is refilling; let them recover.

arguments.text: Rate down again, long strokes, easy on the catch.

text: rate_down cue: 11 percent fade at 63 spm while tired; a lower rate suits a tired paddler.

arguments.text: A touch easier. Find a rhythm you can hold home.

text: ease cue: back at 198 W shaft above the 193 W sustainable level with only 16 percent pod reserve after a blow-up.

arguments.message: about 400 m to go with pod reserve left: time for the finish cue (pod reserve near 17 percent, about 2 kJ, roughly a 40-60 s sprint)

text: no cue: holding about 191 W shaft, at critical power and within the sustainable level; finish watch set for 450 m.
no cue: 194 W shaft is within the 196 W sustainable level; sprint planned near 450 m to go.
no cue: last turn done, 193 W shaft is sustainable; sprint cue planned near 450 m to go.

arguments.text: Not yet. Settle a touch, sprint comes at two hundred.

arguments.message: about 250 m to go: cue finish now and spend what is left of the pod reserve (about 1 kJ, a short sprint)

text: ease cue: 202 W shaft with 10 percent pod reserve would empty 330 m before the line; save it for a sprint at 250 m.

arguments.text: Smooth it a touch, hold your form to the line.

text: ease cue: self-started sprint at 239 W with the pod reserve already empty and 310 m left risks tying up before the line.
no cue: a cue was given seconds ago and 274 m remain in the sprint.
no cue: already sprinting at 257 W with the pod reserve empty, and the last cue was under a minute ago.
no cue: 114 m to go, inside the final stretch.
